# http

## Type Aliases

### ShiitakeHttpEnv

```ts
type ShiitakeHttpEnv = object;
```

Hono variables Shiitake's routes read. Only the host's own middleware sets
`shiitakeMeta`; no request body can, because every body schema is closed.

##### Variables

Opaque host metadata for prompts and operator lines on this request.

### ShiitakeSessionResolver

```ts
type ShiitakeSessionResolver = (
  sessionId,
  meta,
) => Promise<ShiitakeSession> | ShiitakeSession;
```

Resolve one addressed Session for Shiitake's HTTP transport. `meta` is what the
host's middleware attached to this request; a host that attaches none may ignore
it.

#### Parameters

| Parameter   | Type                                        |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `sessionId` | `string`                                    |
| `meta`      | [`Json`](extensions.md#json) \| `undefined` |
